get.description:
Returns the Document Collections for a Project, including the "All Documents" collection tagged `PDM:collection.all_documents`.

Supported filters: `id`, `ids`, `updated_at`.

Pass `view=ids_only` to receive an array of Document Collection ids instead of full objects.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Optional response view. Omit or pass `default` for full Document Collection objects. `ids_only` returns an array of ids and raises the `per_page` ceiling from 100 to 5000. The published `per_page` maximum reflects the default view.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Language for the response to be translated into

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description:
Filter which Document Collections are returned. `id` and `ids` match collection ids and are combined when both are sent. `updated_at` is an inclusive ISO-8601 range `start...end`.
Valid filterable fields are:
id,
ids,
updated_at

200.description: Returns Project Document Collections. The default view returns Document Collection objects; `view=ids_only` returns an array of Document Collection ids instead.

Per-Page.description: Number of items retrieved per page

Total.description: Total number of items to be retrieved

Link.description: Link headers for the first, prev, next and last link

data.description: Document Collection objects by default. When `view=ids_only` is passed, an array of Document Collection ids instead.

tags.description: System-collection markers. Empty for custom collections. Identify the All Documents collection by `PDM:collection.all_documents`; do not use `name`, which is localized and user-editable. Other tags identify the In Review and Published collections.

filters.description: Saved field filters on the collection, including `field.active` and `acceptable_values[].active` / `acceptable_values[].tags`.

active.description: Whether the field is active on the project

import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v2.0/companies/%7Bcompany_id%7D/projects/%7Bproject_id%7D/document_management/document_collections?view=SOME_STRING_VALUE&page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&per_page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&locale=SOME_STRING_VALUE&filters=SOME_OBJECT_VALUE")

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
